[[Mallyx's Defense]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]] that spawns after defeating [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the [[skin]] of an [[Iridescent Aegis]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, exact technical replicas for this item are::
*[[Adamantine Shield]] from crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]] or collector [[Nikun]]
*[[Bronze Shield]] from crafters [[Manzo]], [[Honglei Sun]], [[Mathilde]], [[Gertrud]], [[Theodosus]], or [[Telamon]]
*[[Wooden Buckler]] from collector [[Healer Silja]]

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Aegis of the Condemned]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Tactics)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Tactics Shield]], [[Droknar's Tactics Shield]], [[Sunreach's Shield]], and [[Shield of the Hierophant]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Strength)]], [[Droknar's Strength Shield]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Strength Shield]], [[Shield of the Kinslayer]], and [[Mallyx's Courage]] have nearly identical stats as this item but require [[Strength]].
*[[Mallyx's Supremacy]], [[Shagu's Anthem]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Command)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Command Shield]], and [[Shield of the Condemned]] have stats identical to is item but require [[Command]].
*[[Cyndr's Aegis]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Motivation)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Motivation Shield]], [[Mallyx's Motivation]], and [[Bastion of the Condemned]] have stats identical to this item but require [[Motivation]].
